messages:
maria: quick sync — BetaCorp pushed for earlier access to our new response-pruning heuristic. thinking lightweight gating instead of full experiment matrix. propose: 2% canary (24h), 10% ramp (48h), 100% if green. need concrete launch gates + rollback triggers.
ajay: sounds reasonable. two quick asks: 1) are we keeping quantized model for the canary or full fp16? 2) what perf targets (p95) are we willing to accept during canary?
tasha: SRE: p95 target can’t exceed 300ms for their SLA tier. if p95 > 350ms for two consecutive 1h windows -> abort. also need circuit-breaker in routing to fallback to previous model variant.
dan: product/metrics: we should gate on both quality and infra. quality gate = eval set A (customer-like prompts) — if pass@1 quality drops > 2.5% vs baseline -> rollback. also monitor user-facing error-rate + token-cost delta.
maria: ok on quality gate. for RICE math I computed: reach=40 (BetaCorp + similar accounts), impact=6, confidence=0.7, effort=3 => RICE ~56. still a mid-priority but customer request bumps urgency.
ajay: on model variant: start with quantized Q4 for canary (cheaper), but route small slice to fp16 to validate parity. config suggestion:
```
canary: 2% total_traffic
  - 1.5% -> model:response-prune-q4
  - 0.5% -> model:response-prune-fp16
metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate, eval_quality_delta]
rollback_conds:
  - p95_latency > 350ms for 2 consecutive 1h windows
  - eval_quality_delta < -2.5% over 1000 eval requests
```

tasha: add an ops action: if error_rate spikes > 0.7% for 30m -> immediate scale-up attempt, if unsuccessful -> failover to previous variant. also require manual confirm from oncall before 10% -> 100% ramp.
dan: propose automated regression alert to notify #product and #eng-oncall with link to sample failing prompts and consumer-impact estimate. include A/B eval harness to run nightly against the same seed set.
maria: agree. last piece: launch window — BetaCorp prefers business hours (PST). we should schedule canary start Monday 09:00 PST to ensure quick human responses.
release-bot: scheduled deployment: canary for response-prune-q4 at 1895097600 (Mon 09:00 PST). monitoring hooks: obs.setup/response-prune-canary.
ajay: I'll draft the canary playbook and add the routing policy. can we lock scope to only the pruning heuristic (no other perf changes) so we isolate risk?
maria: yes, scope locked. final ops checklist: 1) playbook in /doc/oncall 2) alert dashboard with runbook links 3) rollback manifest ready 4) stakeholder notify (BetaCorp + CS).
tasha: added. I'll be oncall Monday morning.
dan: I'll add the eval harness and sampling monitors.
maria: thanks all — I'll convert this thread into a short PRD and run the RICE / priority update in tomorrow's triage. :thumbsup:
